CREATE gold.calander
AS
(

SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://saawstoragedatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
    FORMAT='PARQUET'
) as calander
)
